description: Agent Grants: submit an award letter or grant agreement with the application as submitted: the award with the grant, the recipient, the amount and currency, the first and last day of the grant period, each condition it attaches and each reporting duty with its due day; the application with the grant, the applicant, the amount requested and currency, the period it proposed, each condition, commitment or undertaking it states and each report it proposed. The signed report gives the award and the application, the recipient, amount and grant period on each side, each award condition matched to a commitment in the application with every condition that has no counterpart named, and each reporting duty paired with a proposed report, and counts them, and names a divergent award: another recipient, currency, amount or grant period than the application states, a condition in the award with no counterpart in the application and a reporting duty in the award the application did not provide for; then a report due on another day than proposed, a proposed report the award drops and another grant name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An amount, a full period, commitments or reports the award states and the application leaves out, an award period with one end only, or an award that states none of the four leaves the award unverified. The recipient reads as a party without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, the amount compares to the cent in one currency, the period and due dates read as days, and conditions and reports read by their words with plurals folded. This reads an organization’s grant award against its own application: wever_edu-aid-check reads a student’s financial aid award letter, its grants, scholarships, waivers and loans by term, against the disbursements made to that student, and a student’s aid stays with it, while the award check reads a grant award’s amount, period, conditions and reporting against the application it answers; and wever_hire-contract-check reads an engagement contract against the accepted quote and the hiring brief, while the award check reads no hiring contract and awards nothing. Verdict grant_award_divergent, grant_award_partial, grant_award_unverified or grant_award_consistent. POST /api/grant-award-check. Reads the grant records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never applies for a grant, awards one, disburses or moves any money, or judges the merit of an applicant, a project, or a funder’s decision, only whether the records agree with each other and with the terms they were written under, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Grants reads a grant’s records for consistency between documents: a grant application, a proposed budget, an award letter or grant agreement, milestone records, disbursement records, spending records, a progress or final report and a closeout record, each against the call or guidelines, the terms in the call or award, the application as submitted, the schedules in the award, the approved budget, the records it summarizes or the award terms it should agree with. Beside it, the conditional payments rail tools such as wever_conditional-create create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the Job Records tools such as wever_job-cost-brief read the records of paid work orders, while this family keeps no state, moves nothing, commissions no work and reads the grant records in the call against each other and against the terms they were written under. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-grants-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-grants/.
